name: Conventions board: seeded candidates, reject persistence, skill creation
description: Open the Conventions page from the SKILLS LAB sidebar and confirm the seeded candidate board renders (pending card with rule, evidence path:line, confidence %, and the code-counted matching-files figure). Exercise the triage flow over seeded data only — the scan buttons are NEVER clicked, so no model call happens: open the Create-skill modal (server draft merges the one accepted convention) and cancel; reject the pending candidate and prove the decision survives a reload under the All filter; then create the repo-conventions skill through the modal and confirm it lands on the Skills page. Locator notes: sidebar navigation uses find text (role link does not resolve NavItem's nested icon+label anchor); buttons use role+name with three disambiguations: the card's triage toggles carry aria-labels (Accept/Reject candidate) so they cannot substring-collide with the Pending1/Accepted1/Rejected1/All3 filter chips (concatenated chip names — the severity-pill convention), the modal's plain Create submit renders before the toolbar's Create skill in DOM order, and the default Pending filter shows exactly one Reject button. MUTATES seeded data (one reject, one skill create) — needs the hermetic runner's fresh DB; a second run against the same stack would 409 on the duplicate skill name.
